title: Electrical Technician - Hilton Istanbul Bomonti Hotel & Conference Center
desc:
Job Description
Job Title :
Electrical Technician
Work Location :
Hilton Istanbul Bomonti Hotel & Conference Center
Reporting To :
Director of Engineering
An Electrical Technician is responsible for installing, maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing electrical systems and equipment to deliver an excellent Guest and Member experience.
Responsibilities
What will I be doing?
As an Electrical Technician, you will be responsible for performing the following duties to the highest standards:
Operate, maintain, and repair all electrical systems throughout the hotel.
Monitor and effectively utilize the Building Management System (BMS).
Read and record electrical meter readings on a daily basis.
Manage maintenance requests and work orders through the hotel's maintenance management system.
Perform planned preventive maintenance (PPM) activities.
Maintain accurate and up-to-date technical service records.
Conduct routine technical inspections throughout the hotel.
Carry out maintenance and repairs of electrical panels, wiring, and the hotel's electrical infrastructure (excluding work requiring external contractors).
Diagnose faults, install, remove, and repair electric motors.
Troubleshoot and repair electrical faults in guest rooms and public areas.
Perform maintenance, installation, and replacement of lighting fixtures and lamps.
Install, configure, and maintain televisions and other electronic equipment.
Prepare and support the technical setup for meetings, conferences, and special events.
Coordinate and supervise the work of external contractors when required.
Report equipment and material requirements in a timely manner.
Comply with all Health & Safety regulations and hotel operating procedures.
Communicate effectively and work collaboratively with other hotel departments.
Participate actively in the hotel's emergency response team.
Qualifications
What are we looking for?
Skills
An Electrical Technician serving Hilton brands is always working on behalf of our Guests and collaborating with other Team Members. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:
Diploma or vocational qualification in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or a related technical field
MYK (Vocational Qualifications Authority of Türkiye) Vocational Qualification Certificate (preferred, relevant to the profession)
Previous technical service experience in the hospitality industry or similar facilities is preferred
Knowledge of electrical systems, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair
Experience working with Building Management Systems (BMS)
Strong team player with a responsible and proactive approach
Ability to work flexible shifts, including weekends and holidays as required
Strong problem-solving skills with a results-oriented mindset
What's in it for me?
Career and development opportunities in Hilton Hotels Worldwide
Competitive Salary & Wages
Private Health Insurance
“Go Hilton” - discounted room rates in Hilton Hotels Worldwide for yourself and your family members & friends
Indoor Parking Privileges
Complimentary Dry Cleaning for Business Attire
Monthly Transportation Fee
Complimentary Shuttle Bus
50% discount on personal food & beverage consumption in the sister hotels.
14 days paid paternity leave
Opportunity to make a positive impact on environment and community with Travel with Purpose program
